Surat's diamond Diwali break shrinks to 15 days this year, from the usual 25, as factories race to fill Christmas orders.

Lab-grown demand is lifting business; some owners offer a bonus worth 10% of pay for workers returning four to five days after Diwali. Source: Gujarat Samachar, Sandesh, 3-5 Nov.

સુરતના હીરા ઉદ્યોગનું દિવાળી વેકેશન આ વર્ષે 25ના બદલે 15 દિવસનું જ રાખવામાં આવ્યું.

Gold in Surat: 24K Rs12,532/g, 22K Rs11,488/g; silver Rs1,59,804/kg, 5 Nov tape, USD/INR 94.54.
